# ov-1024 landing fix

The landing gate failed twice on two daemon tests, only in batches that include ov-1024 (born-released stores). Log: /tmp/lane-gate-logs-em3v7bq8/rust-5287291.log

1. `crates/daemon/tests/landings_over_the_socket.rs` `a_landing_left_waiting_for_ci_reads_as_landed`: its fixture (`crates/store/src/testing.rs:263`) inserts a legacy landing row and hits the trigger "legacy execution authority retired".
2. `crates/daemon/tests/the_owners_orchestrator_runs_a_cutover.rs:165` `the_owners_orchestrator_takes_a_real_runner_from_prepare_to_finish`: the daemon refuses the cutover hold (Daemon code 12) because the store is born released.

Fix: tests that need a pre-cutover (legacy) store must create one explicitly. Don't weaken the trigger or born-released for real installs. Run the full `cargo nextest run --profile ci --workspace` and `scripts/landing-gate --only rust` before committing. Commit as you go.
